title: Code of the Sith
content: Peace is a lie. There is only Passion. Through Passion, I gain Strength. Through Strength, I gain Power. Through Power, I gain Victory. Through Victory my chains are Broken. The Force shall free me.

title: Rule of Two
content: The Rule of Two was a Sith decree established by Darth Bane around 1032 BBY. It mandated that only two Sith Lords exist at any time: a master to embody power and an apprentice to crave it. This allowed the Sith to operate in secret and eventually destroy the Jedi Order. The apprentice must eventually kill the master to ascend, ensuring the Sith grow more powerful with each generation.

title: C-3PO
content: C-3PO (See-Threepio) is a 3PO-series protocol droid programmed for etiquette and protocol, fluent in over six million forms of communication. Rebuilt by Anakin Skywalker on Tatooine. He is known for being fussy, worry-prone, and extremely loyal. He frequently finds himself in the middle of major galactic conflicts.
